description: This file defines a Blazor component class 'BlazorLayoutComponent' that extends 'LayoutComponentBase'. It manages refresh events through a singleton 'RefreshBroadcast' to trigger UI updates in a Blazor application.

classes.name: BlazorLayoutComponent
